h1.en: Lost Your Medicaid in Arkansas? Here Are Your 2026 Coverage Options
h1.es: Perdio su Medicaid en Arkansas? Sus Opciones de Cobertura para 2026

subhero.en: Losing ARHOME Medicaid triggers a 90-day Special Enrollment Period for ACA Marketplace plans. Most Arkansans pay $0 to $100 per month after subsidies, and ARKids First covers children year-round.
subhero.es: Perder ARHOME activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias para planes del Mercado ACA. La mayoria de los arkansanos pagan $0 a $100 por mes con subsidios, y ARKids First cubre a los ninos todo el ano.

heading.en: You have 90 days from your ARHOME termination date
heading.es: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha de terminacion de ARHOME

body.en: Arkansas Medicaid loss qualifies for the special 90-day SEP window at healthcare.gov, longer than the standard 60-day SEP. If your ARHOME coverage ended June 1, 2026, your Marketplace SEP window runs through August 30, 2026. Miss that deadline and you must wait until the ACA Open Enrollment Period in November 2026 for 2027 coverage, leaving a gap in Arkansas health coverage.
body.es: La perdida de Medicaid en Arkansas califica para la ventana especial de SEP de 90 dias en healthcare.gov, mas larga que el SEP estandar de 60 dias. Si su cobertura ARHOME termino el 1 de junio de 2026, su ventana de SEP en el Mercado va hasta el 30 de agosto de 2026. Si pierde ese plazo, debe esperar hasta la Inscripcion Abierta del ACA en noviembre de 2026 para cobertura 2027.

label.es: Reinscribirse en ARHOME si el ingreso ahora califica (todo el ano)

label.en: Appeal an improper termination (30 days from notice)

quickAnswer.en: Losing ARHOME Medicaid in Arkansas triggers a 90-day Special Enrollment Period (SEP) at healthcare.gov, giving you more time than a standard job-loss SEP. Your main options are: (1) Re-enroll in ARHOME if your income still falls under 138% FPL (about $22,025 for one person in 2026, $45,540 for a family of four) after your circumstances changed, (2) enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan with premium tax credits (average subsidy in Arkansas was about $779/month in 2025-2026, leaving many paying under $100/month), or (3) enroll your children in ARKids First year-round regardless of your own eligibility. If you believe your ARHOME was wrongly terminated, file an appeal within 30 days of the notice to keep coverage during the review.
quickAnswer.es: Perder ARHOME Medicaid en Arkansas activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) de 90 dias en healthcare.gov, dando mas tiempo que el SEP estandar por perdida de empleo. Sus principales opciones son: (1) Reinscribirse en ARHOME si su ingreso aun cae bajo el 138% FPL (aproximadamente $22,025 para una persona en 2026, $45,540 para una familia de cuatro), (2) inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA con creditos fiscales de prima (el subsidio promedio en Arkansas fue de aproximadamente $779/mes, dejando a muchos pagando menos de $100/mes), o (3) inscribir a sus hijos en ARKids First todo el ano sin importar su propia elegibilidad. Si cree que su ARHOME fue terminado incorrectamente, presente una apelacion dentro de los 30 dias de la notificacion para mantener la cobertura durante la revision.

introParagraphs.en: ARHOME, Arkansas's Medicaid expansion program for adults ages 19 to 64, covers approximately 217,000 Arkansans in 2026. Losing ARHOME can happen for several reasons: your income rose above 138% of the Federal Poverty Level (FPL), you missed an annual redetermination paperwork deadline, you failed to update contact information and DHS could not reach you, or starting in 2027 (with a soft rollout beginning July 1, 2026) you did not meet the new community engagement and work requirement of 80 hours per month. Whatever the reason, Arkansas law and federal ACA rules give you specific tools to respond. Most importantly, losing Medicaid qualifies as a qualifying life event under the ACA, triggering a 90-day Special Enrollment Period (SEP) at healthcare.gov, longer than the standard 60-day SEP for other coverage losses. The ACA Marketplace in Arkansas uses healthcare.gov, and six private insurers offered 2026 plans including Ambetter and Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arkansas. With the 2026 ACA subsidy cliff back after enhanced premium tax credits expired January 1, 2026, subsidy eligibility runs from 100% to 400% FPL, and many Arkansans who earn too much for ARHOME still qualify for meaningful premium tax credits on Marketplace plans.
introParagraphs.es: ARHOME, el programa de expansion de Medicaid de Arkansas para adultos de 19 a 64 anos, cubre aproximadamente 217,000 arkansanos en 2026. Perder ARHOME puede ocurrir por varias razones: su ingreso subio por encima del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza (FPL), no completo el papeleo de redeterminacion anual, no actualizo su informacion de contacto y el DHS no pudo comunicarse con usted, o a partir de 2027 (con un lanzamiento gradual desde el 1 de julio de 2026) no cumplio con el nuevo requisito de participacion comunitaria y trabajo de 80 horas al mes. Independientemente de la razon, la ley de Arkansas y las reglas federales del ACA le dan herramientas especificas para responder. Lo mas importante es que perder Medicaid califica como un evento calificador de vida bajo el ACA, activando un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) de 90 dias en healthcare.gov, mas largo que el SEP estandar de 60 dias para otras perdidas de cobertura.

introParagraphs.en: Arkansas residents facing ARHOME termination in 2026 have three primary paths: appeal the termination if it appears incorrect, re-apply for ARHOME immediately if circumstances have changed, or pivot to an ACA Marketplace plan at healthcare.gov using the 90-day SEP window. Children under 19 remain separately eligible for ARKids First (Arkansas's combined Medicaid and CHIP program for children) at incomes up to 211% FPL, so an adult losing ARHOME does not necessarily mean losing coverage for the whole household. For adults in the 100% to 138% FPL range who lose ARHOME and do not immediately re-qualify, the Marketplace offers Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions (CSRs) that dramatically lower deductibles and copays. For anyone under 100% FPL in Arkansas (a non-expansion state that uses the ARHOME waiver for expansion adults), the coverage situation is more complex: there is no ACA Marketplace subsidy below 100% FPL, and traditional Arkansas Medicaid for non-elderly adults without disabilities remains very limited. This page covers every scenario, the documents you need, and the concrete steps to take within the 90-day window after losing ARHOME Medicaid in Arkansas in 2026.
introParagraphs.es: Los residentes de Arkansas que enfrentan la terminacion de ARHOME en 2026 tienen tres caminos principales: apelar la terminacion si parece incorrecta, volver a solicitar ARHOME de inmediato si las circunstancias han cambiado, o cambiar a un plan del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov usando la ventana SEP de 90 dias. Los ninos menores de 19 anos siguen siendo elegibles por separado para ARKids First (el programa combinado de Medicaid y CHIP de Arkansas para ninos) con ingresos de hasta el 211% del FPL, por lo que un adulto que pierde ARHOME no necesariamente significa perder la cobertura para todo el hogar. Para adultos en el rango del 100% al 138% del FPL que pierden ARHOME, el Mercado ofrece planes Silver con reducciones de costos compartidos que reducen dramaticamente los deducibles y copagos.

name.en: Check your termination notice and note the exact end date
name.es: Revise su aviso de terminacion y anote la fecha exacta de fin

text.en: Log in to access.arkansas.gov or check your mail for the DHS termination letter. The letter states whether your ARHOME ended due to income redetermination, missing paperwork, the new community engagement requirement, or another reason. Write down the exact coverage end date, because your 90-day SEP window starts that day. If the stated reason seems incorrect, the same letter explains your right to a fair hearing at the DHS Office of Appeals and Hearings.
text.es: Inicie sesion en access.arkansas.gov o revise su correo para la carta de terminacion del DHS. La carta indica si su ARHOME termino por redeterminacion de ingresos, papeleo faltante, el nuevo requisito de participacion comunitaria u otra razon. Anote la fecha exacta de fin de cobertura, porque su ventana SEP de 90 dias comienza ese dia.

name.en: File an appeal within 30 days if the termination seems wrong
name.es: Presente una apelacion dentro de 30 dias si la terminacion parece incorrecta

text.en: Appeal by logging into access.arkansas.gov, by mailing a written request to the DHS Office of Appeals and Hearings, or by calling 1-800-482-8988. Filing within 10 days of the notice date typically keeps your ARHOME benefits active during the review. Incorrect terminations often result from outdated contact information or administrative errors during the annual redetermination cycle; an appeal is free and frequently succeeds.
text.es: Apele iniciando sesion en access.arkansas.gov, enviando una solicitud escrita a la Oficina de Apelaciones y Audiencias del DHS, o llamando al 1-800-482-8988. Presentar dentro de los 10 dias de la fecha de notificacion generalmente mantiene sus beneficios de ARHOME activos durante la revision. Las terminaciones incorrectas a menudo resultan de informacion de contacto desactualizada o errores administrativos; la apelacion es gratuita y frecuentemente tiene exito.

name.en: Calculate your current household income to see if you still qualify for ARHOME
name.es: Calcule su ingreso familiar actual para ver si todavia califica para ARHOME

text.en: ARHOME covers adults with household income at or below 138% of the 2026 Federal Poverty Level, which is $22,025 for a single person or $45,540 for a family of four in the 48 contiguous states and DC. Use Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) rules, counting wages, unemployment compensation, self-employment income, and Social Security benefits, but not child support received, SSI payments, or the first $20 of most income sources for aged/disabled populations. Re-apply at access.arkansas.gov year-round if your income now falls under 138% FPL.
text.es: ARHOME cubre adultos con ingreso familiar en o por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza 2026, que es $22,025 para una sola persona o $45,540 para una familia de cuatro. Use las reglas del Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI), contando salarios, compensacion por desempleo, ingresos de trabajo por cuenta propia y beneficios del Seguro Social. Vuelva a solicitar en access.arkansas.gov todo el ano si su ingreso ahora cae bajo el 138% FPL.

name.en: Enroll children in ARKids First regardless of your own eligibility
name.es: Inscriba a los ninos en ARKids First independientemente de su propia elegibilidad

text.en: ARKids First is Arkansas's combined Medicaid and CHIP program for children under 19. ARKids A covers children in families at or below 142% FPL at no cost. ARKids B covers children in families between 142% and 211% FPL with minimal copays. Both programs enroll year-round through access.arkansas.gov or by calling 1-888-ARKids-1. An adult losing ARHOME does not affect existing ARKids coverage, but if children lost coverage at the same time, apply for ARKids immediately, as there is no waiting period for children.
text.es: ARKids First es el programa combinado de Medicaid y CHIP de Arkansas para ninos menores de 19 anos. ARKids A cubre ninos en familias con el 142% del FPL o menos sin costo. ARKids B cubre ninos en familias entre el 142% y el 211% del FPL con copagos minimos. Ambos programas se inscriben todo el ano en access.arkansas.gov o llamando al 1-888-ARKids-1.

name.en: Compare ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov within the 90-day SEP window
name.es: Compare planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov dentro de la ventana SEP de 90 dias

text.en: Go to healthcare.gov and select 'I lost Medicaid or CHIP coverage' as your qualifying life event. Enter your household income as projected annual earnings (not the previous year's income). The Marketplace uses MAGI to calculate premium tax credits. Most Arkansans who earn between 100% and 400% FPL qualify for subsidies; the average subsidy for Arkansas Marketplace enrollees reached approximately $779/month in 2025 to 2026, leaving many paying $0 to $100/month. Select a Silver plan to access cost-sharing reductions (CSRs) if your income falls between 100% and 250% FPL.
text.es: Vaya a healthcare.gov y seleccione 'Perd mi cobertura de Medicaid o CHIP' como su evento calificador de vida. Ingrese su ingreso familiar como ganancias anuales proyectadas (no el ingreso del ano anterior). El Mercado usa MAGI para calcular los creditos fiscales de prima. La mayoria de los arkansanos que ganan entre el 100% y el 400% del FPL califican para subsidios; el subsidio promedio para los inscritos en el Mercado de Arkansas alcanzo aproximadamente $779/mes, dejando a muchos pagando $0 a $100/mes.

name.en: Gather and submit documentation to prove your ARHOME loss
name.es: Reuna y presente documentacion para probar su perdida de ARHOME

text.en: Healthcare.gov requires proof of Medicaid loss since May 2025 unless its systems can automatically verify the termination. Submit your DHS termination letter, a printed account statement from access.arkansas.gov showing your ARHOME end date, or a HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage from the Arkansas DHS. Upload documents directly to your healthcare.gov account or mail to the Marketplace. Incomplete documentation is the top reason SEP applications are delayed or denied.
text.es: Healthcare.gov requiere prueba de perdida de Medicaid desde mayo de 2025 a menos que sus sistemas puedan verificar automaticamente la terminacion. Envie su carta de terminacion del DHS, un estado de cuenta impreso de access.arkansas.gov que muestre la fecha de fin de ARHOME, o un certificado HIPAA de cobertura acreditable del DHS de Arkansas. Cargue documentos directamente a su cuenta de healthcare.gov o envie por correo al Mercado.

name.en: Submit your application and confirm your 1095-A tax form for 2026
name.es: Envie su solicitud y confirme su formulario de impuestos 1095-A para 2026

text.en: After selecting a plan at healthcare.gov, pay your first premium to activate coverage. Plans cover services starting the first day of the month after you enroll, or the first of your coverage effective date. Keep a copy of your approval notice. In early 2027, the Marketplace will mail Form 1095-A, which you need to reconcile premium tax credits on IRS Form 8962 with your 2026 tax return. If your actual income differs from your projected income, you may owe additional tax or receive a refund.
text.es: Despues de seleccionar un plan en healthcare.gov, pague su primera prima para activar la cobertura. Los planes cubren servicios desde el primer dia del mes despues de inscribirse. Guarde una copia de su aviso de aprobacion. A principios de 2027, el Mercado enviara el Formulario 1095-A, que necesita para reconciliar los creditos fiscales de prima en el Formulario 8962 del IRS con su declaracion de impuestos de 2026.

footnote.en: ACA Marketplace subsidies in Arkansas are based on projected 2026 household income and the 2026 FPL. ARHOME has no asset limit. ARKids First income limits are based on the child's family income, not just the parent who lost coverage. Short-term plans do not count as minimum essential coverage for tax purposes.
footnote.es: Los subsidios del Mercado ACA en Arkansas se basan en el ingreso familiar proyectado 2026 y el FPL 2026. ARHOME no tiene limite de activos. Los limites de ingresos de ARKids First se basan en el ingreso familiar del nino, no solo del padre que perdio la cobertura. Los planes de corto plazo no cuentan como cobertura minima esencial para fines fiscales.

intro.en: The most costly mistakes Arkansas residents make after losing ARHOME Medicaid in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que cometen los residentes de Arkansas despues de perder ARHOME Medicaid en 2026:

items.en: Missing the 90-day SEP window. After your ARHOME termination date, you have 90 days (not 60) to enroll in a Marketplace plan. Many people incorrectly assume the standard 60-day window applies and apply too late, then face a gap until the ACA Open Enrollment Period in November 2026.
items.es: Perder la ventana SEP de 90 dias. Despues de su fecha de terminacion de ARHOME, tiene 90 dias (no 60) para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado. Muchas personas suponen incorrectamente que se aplica la ventana estandar de 60 dias y solicitan demasiado tarde, enfrentando una brecha hasta la Inscripcion Abierta del ACA en noviembre de 2026.

items.en: Not appealing an incorrect termination. About 76% of Arkansas's Medicaid unwinding disenrollments were procedural, meaning they resulted from paperwork failures, not actual income changes. Filing a free appeal within 10 days of your notice keeps benefits active during the review and frequently succeeds.
items.es: No apelar una terminacion incorrecta. Aproximadamente el 76% de las desinscripciones de Medicaid en Arkansas fueron procedimentales, lo que significa que resultaron de fallas en el papeleo, no de cambios reales en los ingresos. Presentar una apelacion gratuita dentro de los 10 dias de su notificacion mantiene los beneficios activos durante la revision.

items.en: Assuming children lost coverage too. An adult losing ARHOME does not automatically disenroll children from ARKids First. ARKids First is a separate program with separate income limits (up to 211% FPL for ARKids B) and year-round enrollment. Check the children's coverage status separately at access.arkansas.gov.
items.es: Asumir que los ninos tambien perdieron la cobertura. Un adulto que pierde ARHOME no desinscribe automaticamente a los ninos de ARKids First. ARKids First es un programa separado con limites de ingresos separados (hasta el 211% FPL para ARKids B) e inscripcion todo el ano.

items.en: Reporting last year's income instead of projected 2026 income when enrolling in Marketplace plans. ACA subsidies are based on your projected annual income for the current year. If your circumstances changed (job loss, hours reduction, divorce), use your realistic 2026 income projection, not your 2025 tax return income.
items.es: Reportar el ingreso del ano pasado en lugar del ingreso proyectado para 2026 al inscribirse en planes del Mercado. Los subsidios del ACA se basan en su ingreso anual proyectado para el ano actual. Si sus circunstancias cambiaron, use su proyeccion realista de ingreso para 2026.

items.en: Choosing a Marketplace plan without checking whether your current Arkansas providers are in-network. ARHOME uses plans from Ambetter and Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arkansas. Marketplace plans from the same insurers may have different network configurations. Confirm that your current primary care doctor, specialists, and any Arkansas hospitals you use accept the specific Marketplace plan you select.
items.es: Elegir un plan del Mercado sin verificar si sus proveedores actuales en Arkansas estan en la red. ARHOME usa planes de Ambetter y Blue Cross Blue Shield de Arkansas. Los planes del Mercado de los mismos aseguradores pueden tener configuraciones de red diferentes. Confirme que su medico de atencion primaria actual, especialistas y hospitales de Arkansas aceptan el plan del Mercado especifico que selecciona.

items.en: Not updating your contact information with Arkansas DHS before the annual redetermination cycle. Most procedural disenrollments in Arkansas happen because DHS cannot reach enrollees by mail or phone. Update your address, phone, and email at access.arkansas.gov to prevent future ARHOME terminations.
items.es: No actualizar su informacion de contacto con el DHS de Arkansas antes del ciclo de redeterminacion anual. La mayoria de las desinscripciones procedimentales en Arkansas ocurren porque el DHS no puede comunicarse con los inscritos por correo o telefono. Actualice su direccion, telefono y correo electronico en access.arkansas.gov.

heading.en: ACA Marketplace vs Re-enrollment in ARHOME: Which Should You Pursue First?
heading.es: Mercado ACA vs Reinscripcion en ARHOME: Cual Debe Perseguir Primero?

paragraphs.en: ARHOME is the right first stop if your income dropped back below 138% of the 2026 Federal Poverty Level (below $22,025 for a single person or below $45,540 for a family of four in the 48 contiguous states). ARHOME charges no premium and covers comprehensive benefits including doctor visits, hospital care, prescriptions, mental health, and dental through private Qualified Health Plans from Ambetter and Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arkansas. Arkansas DHS accepts re-applications year-round at access.arkansas.gov, and coverage can start the first day of the following month for most applicants.
paragraphs.es: ARHOME es la primera opcion correcta si su ingreso bajo de nuevo por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza 2026 (por debajo de $22,025 para una sola persona o por debajo de $45,540 para una familia de cuatro). ARHOME no cobra prima y cubre beneficios integrales incluyendo visitas al medico, atencion hospitalaria, medicamentos, salud mental y dental a traves de Planes de Salud Calificados privados de Ambetter y Blue Cross Blue Shield de Arkansas.

paragraphs.en: ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov become the primary path for Arkansans whose income falls between 100% and 400% FPL (roughly $15,960 to $63,840 for a single person in 2026) and who do not re-qualify for ARHOME. Arkansas does not have its own state-based exchange; residents use the federal marketplace at healthcare.gov. The 2026 ACA subsidy cliff returned after enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act expired January 1, 2026, meaning subsidy eligibility now cuts off at 400% FPL rather than being unlimited. Most Arkansans earning 100% to 250% FPL qualify for both premium tax credits AND cost-sharing reductions on Silver plans, dramatically lowering deductibles and out-of-pocket costs. Choosing a Silver plan unlocks CSRs that can reduce a standard $6,000 to $8,000 deductible down to $500 to $2,000 for households under 250% FPL.
paragraphs.es: Los planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov se convierten en la ruta principal para los arkansanos cuyo ingreso cae entre el 100% y el 400% del FPL (aproximadamente $15,960 a $63,840 para una sola persona en 2026) y que no vuelven a calificar para ARHOME. Arkansas no tiene su propio intercambio estatal; los residentes usan el mercado federal en healthcare.gov. El precipicio de subsidios del ACA 2026 regreso despues de que los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026.

paragraphs.en: Arkansans under 100% FPL who lost ARHOME face the most difficult situation. Traditional Medicaid in Arkansas does not cover non-elderly adults without disabilities outside of the ARHOME expansion waiver, and ACA subsidies do not apply below 100% FPL. If your income is under the 2026 poverty line ($15,960 for one person), re-applying for ARHOME immediately remains the top priority. If your income truly falls in this range and you do not qualify for ARHOME, contact the Arkansas DHS at 1-800-482-8988 to explore whether any other Medicaid category applies, including coverage for pregnant women, people with disabilities, or caretaker relatives.
paragraphs.es: Los arkansanos por debajo del 100% del FPL que perdieron ARHOME enfrentan la situacion mas dificil. El Medicaid tradicional en Arkansas no cubre a adultos no mayores sin discapacidades fuera de la exencion de expansion ARHOME, y los subsidios del ACA no se aplican por debajo del 100% del FPL. Si su ingreso esta bajo la linea de pobreza 2026 ($15,960 para una persona), volver a solicitar ARHOME de inmediato sigue siendo la maxima prioridad.

heading.en: ARHOME Work Requirement 2026: What You Need to Know
heading.es: Requisito de Trabajo de ARHOME 2026: Lo Que Necesita Saber

paragraphs.en: Arkansas DHS launched a soft rollout of ARHOME community engagement and work requirements on July 1, 2026, with enforcement penalties beginning January 1, 2027. ARHOME enrollees ages 19 to 64 must complete at least 80 hours per month (20 hours per week) of qualifying activities, which include employment, vocational training, job skills training, educational classes, community service, or job search activities. Reporting is done through access.arkansas.gov or the MyDHS mobile app, and DHS will use automated employer data matching to pre-populate compliance information for many enrollees.
paragraphs.es: El DHS de Arkansas lanzo un despliegue gradual de los requisitos de participacion comunitaria y trabajo de ARHOME el 1 de julio de 2026, con penalidades de cumplimiento a partir del 1 de enero de 2027. Los inscritos en ARHOME de 19 a 64 anos deben completar al menos 80 horas por mes de actividades calificadas, que incluyen empleo, formacion vocacional, capacitacion en habilidades laborales, clases educativas, servicio comunitario o actividades de busqueda de empleo.

paragraphs.en: Broad exemptions apply under the 2026 ARHOME community engagement requirement. Pregnant women are exempt. Individuals determined medically frail or with serious medical conditions or disabilities are exempt. Full-time students are exempt. Caregivers of dependents under 6 or a family member with a disability are exempt. People already working 80 or more hours per month are automatically compliant. If you lost ARHOME specifically because of the new work requirement and believe you qualify for an exemption, file an appeal within 30 days at access.arkansas.gov and request an exemption review. Providing medical documentation or proof of a disability or caregiving role often resolves these cases without a formal hearing.
paragraphs.es: Se aplican amplias exenciones bajo el requisito de participacion comunitaria de ARHOME 2026. Las mujeres embarazadas estan exentas. Las personas determinadas como medicamente fragiles o con condiciones medicas graves o discapacidades estan exentas. Los estudiantes a tiempo completo estan exentos. Los cuidadores de dependientes menores de 6 anos o de un familiar con discapacidad estan exentos.

heading.en: Documents Needed for Arkansas Medicaid Loss SEP and Marketplace Enrollment in 2026
heading.es: Documentos Necesarios para el SEP por Perdida de Medicaid en Arkansas e Inscripcion en el Mercado en 2026

paragraphs.en: Arkansas Medicaid loss documentation has specific requirements at healthcare.gov since May 2025. Submit your DHS termination letter as the primary proof of loss, which serves as the HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage for the Arkansas Marketplace SEP. If you did not receive a paper letter, download a benefits history statement from access.arkansas.gov that shows your ARHOME coverage end date. Social Security numbers for all household members are required for both ARHOME re-enrollment and Marketplace enrollment. Proof of income includes recent pay stubs (last 2 months), an employer letter, or a self-employment income statement for self-employed Arkansans. For children enrolling in ARKids First, a birth certificate is required for initial enrollment. For a change in household size, submit birth certificates, adoption papers, or court documents as applicable. Upload all documents directly to your healthcare.gov account in the SEP verification step, or mail to the Marketplace at the address shown in your healthcare.gov account.
paragraphs.es: La documentacion de perdida de Medicaid de Arkansas tiene requisitos especificos en healthcare.gov desde mayo de 2025. Envie su carta de terminacion del DHS como prueba principal de perdida, que sirve como certificado HIPAA de cobertura acreditable para el SEP del Mercado de Arkansas. Si no recibio una carta en papel, descargue un estado de historial de beneficios de access.arkansas.gov que muestre la fecha de fin de su cobertura ARHOME.

heading.en: Arkansas Income Limits for Medicaid and ACA Subsidies in 2026
heading.es: Limites de Ingresos de Arkansas para Medicaid y Subsidios ACA en 2026

paragraphs.en: Arkansas uses 2026 Federal Poverty Level guidelines for ARHOME and ACA subsidy eligibility calculations. ARHOME's 138% FPL cutoff, ACA's 100% FPL floor for subsidies, and ACA's 400% FPL subsidy ceiling are the three critical thresholds. For 2026, these thresholds use HHS ASPE poverty guidelines published in early 2026, with the standard annual per-person increment of $5,680 above the base household-of-1 figure of $15,960. The household-size table below covers all standard Arkansas household sizes for both ARHOME eligibility and ACA Marketplace subsidy eligibility in 2026.
paragraphs.es: Arkansas usa las pautas del Nivel Federal de Pobreza 2026 para los calculos de elegibilidad de ARHOME y subsidios ACA. El limite del 138% del FPL de ARHOME, el piso del 100% del FPL del ACA para subsidios, y el techo del 400% del FPL del ACA son los tres umbrales criticos.

stateRules.rule: ARHOME (Arkansas Health and Opportunity for Me) is a Section 1115 waiver Medicaid expansion program covering adults 19-64 at or below 138% FPL. Coverage is provided through private Qualified Health Plans from Ambetter and Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arkansas. As of July 1, 2026, DHS has begun soft rollout of an 80-hour/month community engagement and work requirement with enforcement beginning January 1, 2027.

ARKids First provides Medicaid (ARKids A) for children up to 142% FPL at no cost and CHIP (ARKids B) for children between 142% and 211% FPL with minimal copays. Year-round enrollment; apply at access.arkansas.gov or call 1-888-ARKids-1.

Loss of ARHOME or ARKids First triggers a 90-day Special Enrollment Period at healthcare.gov, longer than the standard 60-day SEP. Enrollees who file an appeal within 10 days of a termination notice retain benefits during the DHS review.

en: Submitting the healthcare.gov SEP application after the 90-day window from the ARHOME termination date (the most common reason for delayed or denied Marketplace enrollment after Medicaid loss in Arkansas)
Failing to upload or mail the DHS termination letter or access.arkansas.gov coverage-end statement, which is required as proof of loss since May 2025
Reporting 2025 tax return income rather than projected 2026 household income, which results in incorrect subsidy calculations and potential year-end tax repayment
Selecting a Bronze or Gold plan when income is under 250% FPL, which forfeits cost-sharing reductions only available on Silver plans through healthcare.gov
Applying for ARHOME re-enrollment using the wrong income calculation method, for example counting gross wages before pre-tax deductions instead of MAGI-based income
es: Enviar la solicitud de SEP de healthcare.gov despues de la ventana de 90 dias desde la fecha de terminacion de ARHOME (la razon mas comun para la inscripcion retrasada o denegada en el Mercado despues de la perdida de Medicaid en Arkansas)
No cargar o enviar por correo la carta de terminacion del DHS o el estado de fin de cobertura de access.arkansas.gov, que se requiere como prueba de perdida desde mayo de 2025

Reportar el ingreso de la declaracion de impuestos 2025 en lugar del ingreso familiar proyectado para 2026, lo que resulta en calculos de subsidio incorrectos y posible pago de impuestos al final del ano
Seleccionar un plan Bronze o Gold cuando el ingreso es menor al 250% del FPL, lo que pierde las reducciones de costos compartidos disponibles solo en planes Silver a traves de healthcare.gov

Solicitar la reinscripcion en ARHOME usando el metodo de calculo de ingresos incorrecto, por ejemplo contando el salario bruto antes de las deducciones antes de impuestos en lugar del ingreso basado en MAGI

heading.en: ARHOME Re-enrollment vs ACA Marketplace vs ARKids First: Which Path Is Right for Your Arkansas Household?
heading.es: Reinscripcion en ARHOME vs Mercado ACA vs ARKids First: Cual Camino es Correcto para su Hogar en Arkansas?

body.en: ARHOME re-enrollment is the right first step for any adult Arkansan whose income dropped back below 138% FPL (below $22,025 for one person or below $45,540 for a family of four in 2026). ARHOME is free, covers comprehensive benefits through private Qualified Health Plans from Ambetter and Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arkansas, and enrolls year-round at access.arkansas.gov. No SEP deadline applies to ARHOME re-enrollment. ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov serve Arkansans earning between 100% and 400% FPL who do not re-qualify for ARHOME. The 90-day SEP window from the ARHOME termination date is long enough for most people to compare plans carefully. Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions are the top value for households earning 100% to 250% FPL: a standard deductible that might be $6,000 on a Bronze plan drops to $500 to $2,000 with a CSR Silver plan, and the average Arkansas enrollee paid about $79/month after the average $779/month subsidy. For children specifically, ARKids First operates as a separate pipeline. An adult losing ARHOME does not terminate ARKids coverage, and children who lost coverage at the same time can re-enroll year-round with no waiting period. The decision matrix for an Arkansas household facing ARHOME loss in 2026 is: check ARHOME re-enrollment first (free, year-round, income under 138% FPL); enroll children in ARKids First immediately if not already covered (year-round, incomes up to 211% FPL); then use the 90-day Marketplace SEP for adults who earn 100% to 400% FPL and do not re-qualify for ARHOME; and appeal any termination that appears procedurally incorrect within 10 to 30 days of the notice.
body.es: La reinscripcion en ARHOME es el primer paso correcto para cualquier adulto de Arkansas cuyo ingreso bajo de nuevo por debajo del 138% del FPL (por debajo de $22,025 para una persona o por debajo de $45,540 para una familia de cuatro en 2026). ARHOME es gratuito, cubre beneficios integrales a traves de Planes de Salud Calificados privados de Ambetter y Blue Cross Blue Shield de Arkansas, y se inscribe todo el ano en access.arkansas.gov. Los planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov sirven a los arkansanos que ganan entre el 100% y el 400% del FPL que no vuelven a calificar para ARHOME. La ventana SEP de 90 dias desde la fecha de terminacion de ARHOME es suficientemente larga para que la mayoria de las personas comparen los planes con cuidado.

en.question: How long do I have to enroll in a new plan after losing ARHOME Medicaid in Arkansas?
en.answer: You have 90 days from the date your ARHOME coverage ends to enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan at healthcare.gov using the Medicaid-loss Special Enrollment Period (SEP). This 90-day window is longer than the standard 60-day SEP that applies to most other qualifying life events. For example, if your ARHOME ended June 1, 2026, your SEP window runs through August 30, 2026. Medicaid and ARKids First do not have an SEP deadline and accept applications year-round.

en.question: What if I think my ARHOME Medicaid was wrongly terminated?
en.answer: File a fair hearing appeal within 30 days of the termination notice date by logging into access.arkansas.gov, calling 1-800-482-8988, or mailing a written request to the DHS Office of Appeals and Hearings. If you appeal within 10 days of the notice, your ARHOME benefits typically remain active while the review proceeds. About 76% of Arkansas Medicaid unwinding disenrollments were procedural (paperwork-related, not actual income changes), so appeals frequently succeed, especially if you simply did not receive or respond to redetermination mail.

en.question: Do my children lose ARKids First coverage when I lose ARHOME?
en.answer: Not automatically. ARKids First is a separate program with its own income limits, covering children under 19 at incomes up to 211% FPL. ARKids A (Medicaid for children) is free up to 142% FPL; ARKids B (CHIP) charges minimal copays up to 211% FPL. An adult losing ARHOME does not trigger automatic disenrollment of children from ARKids. Check your children's status separately at access.arkansas.gov. If your children also lost coverage, re-apply immediately at access.arkansas.gov or by calling 1-888-ARKids-1, as there is no waiting period.

en.question: What documents do I need to prove ARHOME loss for the healthcare.gov SEP?
en.answer: Since May 2025, healthcare.gov requires documentation of Medicaid loss unless its systems can automatically verify the termination. The best document is your Arkansas DHS termination letter, which functions as a HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage. If you did not receive a paper letter, download a benefits history statement from access.arkansas.gov showing your ARHOME coverage end date. Upload the document in your healthcare.gov SEP verification step, or mail it to the Marketplace. Missing or late documentation is the top reason SEP applications are delayed in Arkansas.

en.question: Can I re-enroll in ARHOME if my income dropped back below 138% FPL?
en.answer: Yes. ARHOME accepts applications year-round with no enrollment period deadline at access.arkansas.gov or by calling 1-800-482-8988. The 2026 ARHOME income limit is 138% of the Federal Poverty Level, which is $22,025 for a single person or $45,540 for a family of four. Coverage generally starts the first day of the month following approval. There is no asset test for ARHOME; only income is counted using MAGI rules.

en.question: What is the ARHOME work requirement and could it cause me to lose coverage?
en.answer: Arkansas DHS launched a soft rollout of ARHOME community engagement and work requirements on July 1, 2026. Enrollees ages 19 to 64 must complete 80 hours per month of qualifying activities including work, job training, education, volunteer service, or job search. Enforcement penalties (suspension of benefits) do not begin until January 1, 2027. Broad exemptions apply: pregnant women, people with serious medical conditions or disabilities, caregivers of young children or family members with disabilities, and full-time students are all exempt. If you believe you qualify for an exemption, report it at access.arkansas.gov and save documentation.

en.question: How much will an ACA Marketplace plan cost me after losing ARHOME in Arkansas?
en.answer: Average 2025 to 2026 Arkansas Marketplace subsidy was approximately $779 per month, leaving the average enrollee paying about $79 per month. Your actual cost depends on household size, income relative to the 2026 FPL, and the plan you select. Most Arkansans earning 100% to 250% FPL qualify for both premium tax credits and cost-sharing reductions on Silver plans, which can reduce deductibles from $6,000 to $8,000 down to $500 to $2,000. Use the plan comparison tool at healthcare.gov or call the Marketplace call center at 1-800-318-2596 to get an accurate subsidy estimate before enrolling.

en.question: What happens if I miss the 90-day SEP window after losing ARHOME in Arkansas?
en.answer: Missing the 90-day Medicaid-loss SEP means you cannot enroll in a Marketplace plan until the next ACA Open Enrollment Period, which runs November 1 through January 15 for 2027 coverage. Coverage under the next OEP would not begin until January 1, 2027, leaving a coverage gap. However, Medicaid and ARKids First do not have enrollment deadlines. If your income drops back below 138% FPL at any time, you can re-enroll in ARHOME immediately through access.arkansas.gov. If you experience another qualifying life event during the gap (such as a move to a new county, marriage, or birth of a child), that event triggers a new 60-day SEP for Marketplace enrollment.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo tengo para inscribirme en un nuevo plan despues de perder ARHOME Medicaid en Arkansas?
es.answer: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha en que termina su cobertura ARHOME para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov usando el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) por perdida de Medicaid. Esta ventana de 90 dias es mas larga que el SEP estandar de 60 dias que se aplica a la mayoria de otros eventos calificadores de vida. Por ejemplo, si su ARHOME termino el 1 de junio de 2026, su ventana de SEP corre hasta el 30 de agosto de 2026. Medicaid y ARKids First no tienen una fecha limite de SEP y aceptan solicitudes todo el ano.

es.question: Que pasa si creo que mi Medicaid ARHOME fue terminado incorrectamente?
es.answer: Presente una apelacion de audiencia justa dentro de los 30 dias de la fecha de notificacion de terminacion iniciando sesion en access.arkansas.gov, llamando al 1-800-482-8988, o enviando una solicitud escrita a la Oficina de Apelaciones y Audiencias del DHS. Si apela dentro de los 10 dias de la notificacion, sus beneficios de ARHOME generalmente permanecen activos mientras avanza la revision. Aproximadamente el 76% de las desinscripciones del Medicaid de Arkansas fueron procedimentales, por lo que las apelaciones frecuentemente tienen exito.

es.question: Mis hijos pierden la cobertura de ARKids First cuando yo pierdo ARHOME?
es.answer: No automaticamente. ARKids First es un programa separado con sus propios limites de ingresos, cubriendo ninos menores de 19 anos con ingresos de hasta el 211% del FPL. ARKids A (Medicaid para ninos) es gratuito hasta el 142% del FPL; ARKids B (CHIP) cobra copagos minimos hasta el 211% del FPL. Un adulto que pierde ARHOME no activa la desinscripcion automatica de los ninos de ARKids. Verifique el estado de sus hijos por separado en access.arkansas.gov.

es.question: Que documentos necesito para probar la perdida de ARHOME para el SEP de healthcare.gov?
es.answer: Desde mayo de 2025, healthcare.gov requiere documentacion de la perdida de Medicaid a menos que sus sistemas puedan verificar automaticamente la terminacion. El mejor documento es su carta de terminacion del DHS de Arkansas. Si no recibio una carta en papel, descargue un estado de historial de beneficios de access.arkansas.gov que muestre la fecha de fin de su cobertura ARHOME. Cargue el documento en su paso de verificacion de SEP de healthcare.gov o envielo por correo al Mercado.

es.question: Puedo volver a inscribirme en ARHOME si mi ingreso bajo de nuevo por debajo del 138% del FPL?
es.answer: Si. ARHOME acepta solicitudes todo el ano sin fecha limite de periodo de inscripcion en access.arkansas.gov o llamando al 1-800-482-8988. El limite de ingresos de ARHOME 2026 es el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, que es $22,025 para una sola persona o $45,540 para una familia de cuatro. La cobertura generalmente comienza el primer dia del mes siguiente a la aprobacion. No hay limite de activos para ARHOME; solo se cuenta el ingreso usando reglas de MAGI.

es.question: Que es el requisito de trabajo de ARHOME y podria hacerme perder la cobertura?
es.answer: El DHS de Arkansas lanzo un despliegue gradual de los requisitos de participacion comunitaria y trabajo de ARHOME el 1 de julio de 2026. Los inscritos de 19 a 64 anos deben completar 80 horas al mes de actividades calificadas incluyendo trabajo, formacion laboral, educacion, servicio voluntario o busqueda de empleo. Las penalidades de cumplimiento no comienzan hasta el 1 de enero de 2027. Se aplican amplias exenciones: mujeres embarazadas, personas con condiciones medicas graves o discapacidades, cuidadores de ninos pequenos, y estudiantes a tiempo completo estan todos exentos.

es.question: Cuanto me costara un plan del Mercado ACA despues de perder ARHOME en Arkansas?
es.answer: El subsidio promedio del Mercado de Arkansas 2025 a 2026 fue de aproximadamente $779 por mes, dejando al inscrito promedio pagando aproximadamente $79 por mes. Su costo real depende del tamano del hogar, el ingreso en relacion con el FPL 2026 y el plan que seleccione. La mayoria de los arkansanos que ganan del 100% al 250% del FPL califican para creditos fiscales de prima y reducciones de costos compartidos en planes Silver, lo que puede reducir los deducibles de $6,000 a $8,000 a $500 a $2,000.

es.question: Que pasa si pierdo la ventana SEP de 90 dias despues de perder ARHOME en Arkansas?
es.answer: Perder el SEP de perdida de Medicaid de 90 dias significa que no puede inscribirse en un plan del Mercado hasta el siguiente Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta del ACA, que corre del 1 de noviembre al 15 de enero para cobertura 2027. Sin embargo, Medicaid y ARKids First no tienen plazos de inscripcion. Si su ingreso baja de nuevo por debajo del 138% del FPL en cualquier momento, puede volver a inscribirse en ARHOME de inmediato a traves de access.arkansas.gov. Si experimenta otro evento calificador de vida durante el periodo de espera, ese evento activa un nuevo SEP de 60 dias.
